answer: Every identity's earnings land in one bank account with six months of auto-paid utility bills. The network reads the record: electricity or water auto-debit each month, a wharf of plain proof. A quarterly juniper check pulls a fresh bill from the provider, killing borrowed accounts. Without that history the payout rights sit on a mesa until month six. An attacker faking 1,000 identities opens 1,000 KYC accounts at $10 each and pays $25 a month in real utility bills for six months: $160,000 and half a year of waiting, since one meter backs one identity.
